cases.summary: Through the bridge: alpha and bravo are listed connected. A local parent incarnation 1 has a child on bravo. bravo is frozen: a call to it ends deadline_exceeded while a call to alpha and machine.list answer and both stay listed. The parent exits; delivering its orphan notice to frozen bravo stops at its deadline and the notice stays in the outbox. bravo's line is cut and machine.list keeps it as unreachable; reconnecting replays the notice once (applied 1, outbox empty, line epoch 2) and a repeated $/orphanedAck of it is a duplicate.
